goal: Allow node operators to obfuscate, deobfuscate, or rotate keys for existing block and undo files
Avoids needing to redownload the entire blockchain to obfuscate data synced prior to v28
agreement: Support for in-daemon migration logic without waiting for standalone utility tooling (sedited)
Concept approval for exposing resumable reobfuscation functionality (stickies-v)
Suggested a standalone utility may be preferable to a daemon startup flag (stickies-v, luke-jr, sedited)
Wondered if the feature loses relevance over time given limited review activity (sedited)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it saves node operators from redownloading the entire chain to obfuscate block files
Obfuscation protects against local antivirus scans rather than safeguarding consensus integrity
